newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gle Eaux confirms talks on Seperef sale.
newsitem.headline: Gle Eaux confirms talks on Seperef sale.

text.p: French water and utilities company Cie Generale des Eaux confirmed on Monday it was in negotiations for the sale of its Seperef SA subsidiary to Tessenderlo of Belgium.
"I confirm we are in negotiations with Tessenderlo with a view to a sale of Seperef. Nothing has been decided yet," a Generale des Eaux spokesman said.

The Belgian firm earlier said it planned to buy 100 percent of the French plastic pipes company which has annual turnover of 280 million French francs. The Generale des Eaux spokesman said the disposal was part of an asset sale programme to reduce debt. pnt
